mapper.select: SELECT #{perfMonth,jdbcType=VARCHAR} PERF_MONTH,base.PLO_NUM,PLO_NAME,DEPT_NUM,DEPT_GROUP,JOB_LEVEL,t1.SAP_ID,base.PERF_UNIT,t2.SUBSIDY_NAME SUBSIDY_UNIT,base.PERF_UNIT ORI_PERF_UNIT,HUM_FLAG,GROUP_FLAG,DEPT_FLAG FROM (SELECT PLO_NUM,PLO_NAME,DEPT_NUM,DEPT_GROUP,JOB_LEVEL, (CASE WHEN JOB_LEVEL in ( '100', '102','103' ,'104','105') then 1 else 0 end) HUM_FLAG, (CASE WHEN JOB_LEVEL in ( '100', '102','103' ,'104','105','101','106','107','108','109') then 1 else 0 end) GROUP_FLAG, (CASE WHEN JOB_LEVEL in ( '100', '102','103' ,'104','105','101','106','107','108','109','199') then 1 else 0 end) DEPT_FLAG, (case when dept_num = '3100' and JOB_LEVEL in ('100', '102','103' ,'104','105') then '网服团队' when DEPT_NUM between '3200' and '3400' or DEPT_NUM between '3600' and '4000' then '金普卡团队' when DEPT_NUM = '3500' then '融媒体团队' else '' end ) PERF_UNIT FROM CUS_EMP_INFO WHERE DEPT_NUM BETWEEN '3006' AND '4000' AND ( PLO_STATUS='00' or PLO_STATUS='01' and OUT_DATE between TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(concat(#{perfMonth,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'-26'),'YYYY-MM-DD'), -1),'YYYY-MM-DD') and concat(#{perfMonth,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'-25')) ) base LEFT JOIN (SELECT PLO_NUM,lpad(PLO_SAP,8,'0') SAP_ID FROM CUS_HR_INFO) t1 on (base.PLO_NUM = t1.PLO_NUM) LEFT JOIN (select a.SUBSIDY_NAME,b.codeval perf_unit from CUS_HR_SUBSIDY_UNIT a left join (SELECT code,codeval FROM SYS_DICT WHERE name ='bpms_perf_unit') b on (a.PERF_UNIT= b.code) where a.status = 1) t2 on (base.PERF_UNIT = t2.PERF_UNIT)

SELECT CASE_ID UNIT_CASE_ID, PLO_NUM, CODEVAL AS PERF_UNIT, NVL( SUBSIDY_NAME, '未定义' ) SUBSIDY_UNIT, IF_PERF HUM_FLAG FROM ( SELECT CASE_ID, PLO_NUM, PERF_UNIT, IF_PERF, row_number () over ( partition BY PLO_NUM ORDER BY MODIFY_TIME DESC ) rn FROM CUS_FLOW_PERF_UNIT WHERE #{ perfMonth, jdbcType = VARCHAR } BETWEEN BEG_MONTH AND END_MONTH AND FLOW_STATUS = 1 ) a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT code, codeval FROM SYS_DICT WHERE name = 'bpms_perf_unit' ) b ON ( a.PERF_UNIT = b.code ) LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PERF_UNIT, SUBSIDY_NAME FROM CUS_HR_SUBSIDY_UNIT WHERE status = 1 ) c ON ( a.PERF_UNIT = c.PERF_UNIT ) WHERE rn =1
